changes.change: Deprecate the rule that rejects any non-Key-Vault secret group. Replace it with evidence-based secret handling checks; encrypted Azure DevOps secret variables must not fail solely for lacking Key Vault.
changes.acceptance: An encrypted secret variable outside Key Vault is not a failure; demonstrably exposed plaintext secrets still fail; missing collection is Unknown.

changes.change: Retire the unconditional inheritPermissions=false requirement. Evaluate effective edit/run/manage rights and sensitive pipeline privileges.
changes.acceptance: A correctly limited inherited ACL passes; a user with unauthorized edit/queue/manage permission fails; insufficient ACL evidence is Unknown.

changes.change: Stop failing on inheritance alone. Check effective administration, check modification, and deployment privileges.
changes.acceptance: Inherited least-privilege access passes; excessive production deployment or check-admin access fails.

changes.change: Evaluate effective release pipeline administration and deployment rights instead of inheritance.
changes.acceptance: Safe inheritance passes and excessive release privileges fail.

changes.change: Evaluate effective repository permissions including policy bypass, force-push and permission management instead of forbidding inheritance.
changes.acceptance: Inherited read access passes; unauthorized dangerous permissions fail.

changes.change: Replace blanket inheritance failure with effective service-connection use/admin/authorization checks.
changes.acceptance: Inherited narrow access passes; unauthorized production endpoint access fails.

changes.change: Replace inheritance prohibition with effective variable-group administration and authorization checks.
changes.acceptance: Least-privilege inheritance passes; inappropriate secret-group use or administration fails.

changes.change: Preserve has-policy diagnostic, but map it to one branch-protection risk objective with IsEnabled.
changes.acceptance: A branch without policy shows useful diagnostics but contributes only one root-risk finding.

changes.change: Preserve enabled-policy diagnostic. Do not count a missing and disabled policy as independent identical exposures.
changes.acceptance: Policy absent versus disabled remain distinct details without double-counting.

changes.change: Group default-branch policy existence with enabled state in scoring, preserving raw results.
changes.acceptance: One default-branch protection objective per repository.

changes.change: Maintain enabled-state check; correlate with default-branch existence.
changes.acceptance: A disabled existing policy reports the right cause; weighted scores remain deduplicated.

changes.change: Correct documentation: code uses enforceJobAuthScope for non-release; this is already distinct from release. DO NOT merge implementations.
changes.acceptance: Help cites non-release field; synthetic tests show release and non-release can independently pass/fail.

changes.change: Retain the release control using enforceJobAuthScopeForReleases. Correct documentation if it conflates with non-release.
changes.acceptance: Both rules remain independent and test each target property.

changes.change: Keep generic environment check protection distinct from human-approval governance; link both to shared production risk grouping.
changes.acceptance: Automated checks alone satisfy this specific check when effective; no double charge for one missing gate.

changes.change: Require human approval only when an explicit deployment policy mandates it; assess approved equivalent gates when permitted.
changes.acceptance: Approved automation does not fail an optional manual-approval standard; required human gate absent fails.

changes.change: Retain protection check separately from human approval; correlate common missing production gate.
changes.acceptance: Missing gate has one primary exposure with distinct drill-down findings.

changes.change: Require human approval only for production connections covered by approved human-review policy.
changes.acceptance: Unapproved bypass fails; authorized automation is not incorrectly called a critical failure.

changes.change: Stop demanding hard-coded CET. Move to an opt-in organization-configuration policy with an expected time zone parameter.
changes.acceptance: US/other valid time zones do not fail a general security baseline; explicit time zone policy is evaluated.

changes.change: Move Europe requirement to regional-compliance policy parameter, not universal default.
changes.acceptance: Regions allowed by a declared residency policy pass; unspecified policy yields Not applicable.

changes.change: Move out of core security baseline; validate only against approved assignment-billing policy.
changes.acceptance: Billing preferences cannot change project security posture.

changes.change: Move to financial-governance baseline, with explicit expected enable/disable state.
changes.acceptance: Non-enterprise billing is not a security violation unless prohibited by approved policy.

changes.change: Move to governance/documentation maturity and lower default impact.
changes.acceptance: Missing org description does not increase measured security exposure.

changes.change: Assess license file only for distributed/open repositories or where licensing policy says it applies.
changes.acceptance: Private application code with no distribution requirement is Not applicable.

changes.change: Keep README completeness under engineering-maturity baseline rather than risk scoring.
changes.acceptance: Missing README changes maturity but not core security risk.

changes.change: Treat GHAS enablement as a licensed vendor-specific optional control; security scanning coverage must consider approved equivalents.
changes.acceptance: Equivalent approved scanning does not cause vendor-product lock-in; disabled license-gated feature is Not applicable in NoExtraLicense.

changes.change: Require effective push-time secret protection only where mandated, allowing validated alternatives.
changes.acceptance: Documented equivalent prevention passes or is represented as compensated; license-inapplicable results do not fail.

changes.change: Make SSH prohibition an opt-in authentication policy; SSH with approved controls is permitted.
changes.acceptance: Approved SSH authentication is not a default Severe finding.

changes.change: Policy-driven: distinguish approved guest collaboration from unauthorized external access.
changes.acceptance: Approved governed guests do not fail automatically; unauthorized exposure fails.

changes.change: Replace unconditional OAuth ban with policy-approved third-party application authentication.
changes.acceptance: Approved OAuth integrations do not fail general security baseline.

changes.change: Respect approved public-project use cases, using explicit public-project baseline or documented exception.
changes.acceptance: Approved public projects pass relevant public settings; inadvertent anonymous exposure fails.

changes.change: Public visibility is permissible only when explicitly approved; preserve high severity for exposure of confidential assets.
changes.acceptance: Approved public project passes via explicit baseline; confidential public project fails.

changes.change: Replace universal pinning with approved supported image and lifecycle policy, including exceptions.
changes.acceptance: Supported intentionally floating image passes; EOL/unapproved agent fails where evidence is available.

changes.change: Check a configured retention threshold justified by actual evidence/audit requirements.
changes.acceptance: Approved retention profile passes regardless of hard-coded days; absent profile is Not applicable.

changes.change: Make PR run retention policy configurable for its evidence class.
changes.acceptance: Correct per-class retention passes; inappropriate fixed default no longer generates risk.

changes.change: Normalize to Low by default; only escalate when badge detail reveals sensitive operational information.
changes.acceptance: Badge exposure alone does not count as Severe security risk.

changes.change: Normalize badge visibility to Low by default; keep control for disclosure review.
changes.acceptance: Organization-wide badge visibility does not dominate weighted risk.

changes.change: Downgrade to Medium and allow threshold/approved administrative operating model; assess privilege quality.
changes.acceptance: Five justified admins no longer automatically imply Severe security risk.

changes.change: Downgrade to Medium continuity control; permit centralized recovery/break-glass arrangements.
changes.acceptance: Legitimate one-admin-plus-break-glass patterns can be assessed contextually.

changes.change: Reclassify as business continuity, Medium unless service interruption is demonstrated.
changes.acceptance: Inactive billing is not reported as a severe security vulnerability.

changes.change: Downgrade to Medium governance/accountability control.
changes.acceptance: Missing owner remains actionable without inflating security score.

changes.change: Downgrade to Low privacy preference unless policy/legal context requires greater priority.
changes.acceptance: Privacy setting is not misclassified as technical security exposure.

changes.change: Downgrade to High by default; escalate only when exposed scope/permissions support Critical.
changes.acceptance: Legacy Classic Azure without demonstrated exposure does not automatically become Critical.
